title: Website teaching and navigation aids: conceptual records, scripted samples and keyboard bypass
goal: Use finite public teaching/navigation aids without mistaking local illustrations, sample decisions, browser focus intent or historical progress context for genuine approval, authentic media or live operational evidence.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local preview. This article covers three preserved source guides, not complete website/product controls or destination workflows.

Product conceptual workflow and scripted demo use local sample state, not signed-in app/account, authentic native screenshots/recordings, provider requests or genuine approvals. No current browser/native/provider/access/flag state was observed.

Historical tour manifest includes mutable master-plan context. That entry is preserved only inside historical evidence and excluded from current source/article runtime bindings; no current master hash or runtime-coverage inference.
permissions: Selecting concept/story/step/context/decision changes local explanation/sample state only. It grants no account/connector/role/AI-credit/cloud authority and performs no underlying product approval/check/publish/deploy.

Genuine independent human approval and separate supported execution controls remain mandatory in actual workflows. Simulate approval is sample presentation, not a persisted server decision or permission.

Ordinary documentation/download/site links navigate destinations; destination may load its own status/data. Navigation does not establish current account/provider health or zero child effects; no actual link/Skip action was performed here.

No copied competitor assets, new media, operational capability or authority are introduced by this authoring. Existing source illustration is not authentic B3 evidence, source hash is not runtime/customer acceptance.
